prompt: Camera nearly still, the slightest drift in. The man keeps his palm pressed to his forehead a moment longer, then pushes it back through his hair and shakes his head very slightly. The woman, eyes still closed, lets out one breath, presses her lips together and gives a tiny rueful nod. He takes a slow sip from his coffee cup. Their sizes and faces stay exactly as framed, both turned towards the machine. Sound: soft arcade hum, muffled beeps from nearby cabinets, the machine's idle whirr.
